title: Admin Sample — Library Membership Call
transcript:
STAFF: Riverside Library, good morning.
CALLER: Hello, I'd like to register for membership please.
STAFF: Certainly. May I take your surname?
CALLER: It's Patel.
STAFF: And your address?
CALLER: 14 Oak Lane.
STAFF: Membership is free for local residents. You'll receive your card in about three days.
CALLER: Perfect, thank you.

question_groups.instruction: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.prompt: Why does the caller phone the library?
How much does membership cost for local residents?

question_groups.instruction: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER.
